body: New source-only design assignment, separate from the not-yet-frozen AppModel adapter API. Against current origin/main435307e3 or later, design the minimal non-disposing Document close preparation needed by accepted APPMODEL-RECOVERY-BARRIER-PLAN section7. Current DocumentWorkspace.close saves then immediately discards, or discards immediately on Dont Save (including dirty/no-window path), so it cannot participate safely in staged Quit. Specify concrete proposed prepare/commit/cancel API, strong document ownership, captured identity/edit-generation checks, exact-once completion, Save/Cancel/Dont Save, saveAs cancellation/error, multiple documents, missing window, pending Text/brush/tool drafts and cancellation after asynchronous save. Do not dispose controllers until final commit. Add deterministic proposed tests using injected prompts/save completions. This request is design/source-inspection only: no product edits, no dependency on evolving A SaveGate type, no builds/tests/apps/benchmarks or heartbeat restart. Publish a small design note and Git result; A will separately authorize Document implementation after contract review. A owns AppModel and main merges; B retains Document ownership.
